content:
nina: Heads up - support reported route attribution gaps for a customer after the SDK header normalization landed. SDKs are dropping `slot` kv in `X-Redwood-Route` and quota attribution goes to default. Need a quick cross-sdk fix + telemetry.

leo: saw that. quick fix = pass-through unknown kv pairs and emit a metric so we can detect adoption.

oliver: agree. propose `redwood.client.route_preserved=1` tag lang=python/ts/go and a config `preserveRouteMeta=true` defaulting to true for the next patch.

nina: add opt-out header `X-Redwood-Route-Privacy: opt-out` to honor accounts that don't want route meta emitted. Console will only ingest hashed slot.

leo: infra note - will add a small processor to map that metric into our `route-events` topic so dashboards get consistent signal. Also add a tolerance in quota reconciler: if >3% traffic moves to default, page.

oliver: tests - unit header passthrough + staging integration asserting `route-events` contains `slot_hash`. Use sha256 truncated.

infra-bot: canary deploy started for sdk-py v1.5-canary -> 10% internal traffic.

nina: owners: leo -> python/ts patches, oliver -> infra mapping + console tile, nina -> runbook + oncall checklist. Sync 11am tomorrow.
